name: Home owner changes the password from the profile and signs in again
title: SC-06-04-02 Home owner changes the password from the profile and signs in again
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the home owner is signed in
When the home owner changes the password from the profile sheet and logs out
Then signing in with the new password succeeds
And the old password is rejected
